elevationAssistant.title: Elevation Assistant
elevationAssistant.description: Create administrator shortcuts for common tools and diagnose their permission requirements
elevationAssistant.privilegeAdminHint: The current SiYuan process is elevated, so child processes started by the plugin also have administrator rights.
elevationAssistant.privilegeStandardHint: SiYuan is not elevated. The plugin cannot elevate silently; after creating a shortcut with the administrator flag, Windows shows a UAC prompt when it is launched.
elevationAssistant.privilegeUacOffHint: UAC is disabled; programs under an administrator account may run at high integrity directly.
elevationAssistant.envNotSupported: Unsupported environment (Windows desktop and Node.js are required)
elevationAssistant.emptyTools: No tools yet. Add a common exe to get started.
elevationAssistant.name: Name
elevationAssistant.nameHint: Used as the shortcut file name; cannot contain \ / : * ? " < > |
elevationAssistant.argumentsHint: Optional, written to the shortcut as-is
elevationAssistant.workingDirHint: Leave empty to use the exe folder
elevationAssistant.requireAdminHint: When enabled, the shortcut carries the administrator flag and Windows shows UAC on launch.
elevationAssistant.requireAdminWarning: The target manifest requires administrator rights; launching it may still trigger UAC when this is off.
elevationAssistant.customDirPlaceholder: Choose a folder for the shortcut
elevationAssistant.diagnoseEmpty: Choose a tool or browse any exe to start diagnosing.
elevationAssistant.externalManifestWarning: An external .manifest was found; Windows may ignore it. Verify actual behavior by launching the program.
elevationAssistant.reasonRequireAdministrator: The manifest requires administrator rights (requireAdministrator); double-clicking the program itself also triggers UAC.
elevationAssistant.reasonHighestAvailable: The program requests the highest available privileges (highestAvailable); it elevates under an administrator account.
elevationAssistant.reasonAsInvoker: The program runs with the caller's privileges (asInvoker); turn on elevation manually if it still needs administrator rights.
elevationAssistant.reasonUiAccess: The program declares uiAccess, which usually requires elevation in practice.
elevationAssistant.reasonManifestMissing: No manifest was found; Windows treats it as asInvoker by default. Turn on elevation manually if it still reports insufficient permissions.
elevationAssistant.reasonParseError: Unable to parse the manifest; confirm the permission requirement manually.
elevationAssistant.reasonReadError: Unable to read target file information.
elevationAssistant.reasonTargetMissing: The target file does not exist.
elevationAssistant.deleteToolMessage: The tool will be removed and its shortcuts will be moved to the recycle bin when possible.
elevationAssistant.overwriteMessage: A shortcut with the same name already exists. Overwrite it?
elevationAssistant.toolLimitReached: At most 50 tools can be saved
elevationAssistant.shortcutExistsError: A shortcut with the same name already exists at the target location
elevationAssistant.toolSavedShortcutFailed: Tool saved, but shortcut creation failed
elevationAssistant.shortcutDeletePartial: Tool deleted, but some shortcuts could not be moved to the recycle bin
elevationAssistant.nameReserved: Name is a reserved Windows device name
elevationAssistant.nameTrailing: Name cannot end with a dot or space
elevationAssistant.pathNotFile: Target path is not a file
elevationAssistant.workDirNotAbsolute: Working directory must be an absolute path
elevationAssistant.workDirTooLong: Working directory path is too long
elevationAssistant.workDirNotDir: Working directory is not a folder
elevationAssistant.customDirNotDir: Custom folder is not a folder

enableElevationAssistantDesc: Create administrator shortcuts for common tools and diagnose their permission requirements
